must_identify.item: The container being killed is the log-shipper sidecar, not the api container
must_identify.evidence: The primary `api` container in the same pods remained healthy and ready throughout [6], confirming the crash loop originates solely from the sidecar; however, because both containers share a pod, the pod as a whole never becomes Ready, preventing the deployment from satisfying its minimum replica availability [4].

must_identify.item: The sidecar is OOMKilled because its 16Mi limit is below its usage
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a newly introduced `log-shipper` sidecar container added in deployment revision 2 of `api` [7], which allocates a buffer during startup far exceeding its configured memory limit of 16Mi [6, 7]. This mismatch causes an immediate out-of-memory condition on every container start, resulting in repeated `OOMKilled` terminations (exit code 137) [4, 6].

notes: The RCA identifies the cause correctly but never recommends a fix, such as raising the sidecar limit or rolling back. A reviewer may also want to confirm the claim that the old ReplicaSet api-f64486c4c is still 1/1 Ready.
